description: This Java class defines a command called ModifyPolicyEntries that modifies PolicyEntry objects within a policy management system. It provides methods to create instances from parameters or JSON, and handles serialization details related to JSON structures used in policy modification commands.

classes.name: ModifyPolicyEntries
classes.description: An immutable command class that modifies policy entries within a specific policy identified by PolicyId. It handles creation from JSON, collection of policy entries, and serialization logic.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ModifyPolicyEntries from a PolicyId, iterable of PolicyEntry, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a ModifyPolicyEntries instance from a JSON string or JSON object, along with headers.

methods.name: getPolicyEntries
methods.description: Returns the list of PolicyEntry objects that will be modified.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the PolicyId associated with this modification command.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Serializes the policy entries into a JSON object following the specified schema version.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON Pointer represented path for the resource, which is '/entries'.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Helper method to append the command's payload to a JSON object builder according to schema version and predicate filters.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated DittoHeaders.
